title: Design System: Submarine Museums of the World

display.purpose: Cover title only; second line outlined, never filled.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the operations console title.

title.purpose: Dossier names, rail titles, era plate names.

label.purpose: Codes, counts, years, ranges, field labels and table cells.

shadows.name: contact-glow
shadows.purpose: Live contact dot transmitting in its propulsion colour.

shadows.name: contact-ring
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation halo under a contact dot.

shadows.name: lock-glow
shadows.purpose: The single locked contact; alarm colour only.

shadows.name: selected-rule
shadows.purpose: Selected row in the contact log and register.

motion.name: ease-instrument
motion.purpose: Default state transition: colour, border, transform. 140–200ms.

motion.name: gate-fade
motion.purpose: Clearance gate out; the only long transition at entry.

motion.name: lock-ping
motion.purpose: Expanding ring on the locked contact.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: Sonar sweep over the plot; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Console drops to two columns, nav collapses, register dossier moves below the list.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Rail to 54px, static 82svh plot with ink fade, single-column cover, stacked console.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single amber action: enter the archive, open a file, open the register.
components.css: .ds-btn-amber { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; padding:19px 28px; border:1px solid transparent; background:var(--amber,#ffb648); color:var(--ink,#04070a); font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.22em; line-height:1; text-transform:uppercase; border-radius:0; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-btn-amber:hover { background:#ffc76a; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-amber:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-amber:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--amber,#ffb648); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Secondary action: open a dossier, open the playlist, dismiss.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; padding:15px 22px; border:1px solid rgba(232,241,245,.13); background:rgba(6,12,17,.35); color:var(--txt,#e8f1f5); font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.22em; line-height:1; text-transform:uppercase; border-radius:0; cursor:pointer; transition:color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { border-color:var(--amber,#ffb648); color:var(--amber,#ffb648); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--amber,#ffb648); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Propulsion filters carry a data dot; situation filters carry the archive's badge glyph. Both show a live count.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 11px; border:1px solid rgba(232,241,245,.13); background:transparent; color:var(--dim,#93a9b2); font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; border-radius:0; cursor:pointer; transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-chip i { width:7px; height:7px; flex:none; border-radius:50%; background:var(--chip,#93a9b2); } .ds-chip img { width:16px; height:16px; flex:none; display:block; } .ds-chip b { font-weight:400; color:var(--mut,#7d949e); font-size:9px; } .ds-chip:hover { color:var(--txt,#e8f1f5); border-color:rgba(232,241,245,.3); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color:var(--amber,#ffb648); border-color:rgba(255,182,72,.55); background:rgba(255,182,72,.14); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] b { color:var(--amber,#ffb648); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--amber,#ffb648); outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { border:1px solid rgba(232,241,245,.13); background:rgba(5,10,14,.9); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px); border-radius:0; padding:18px; color:var(--txt,#e8f1f5); font-family:var(--sans,'Archivo',sans-serif); } .ds-panel-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding-bottom:14px; margin-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,241,245,.07); } .ds-panel-label { font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.24em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--amber,#ffb648); } .ds-panel-meta { font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--mut,#7d949e); } .ds-panel-copy { margin:0; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--dim,#93a9b2); max-width:44ch; }

components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:40px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid rgba(232,241,245,.13); background:rgba(4,7,10,.6); border-radius:0; transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:rgba(255,182,72,.55); } .ds-search svg { flex:none; stroke:var(--mut,#7d949e); } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-width:0; border:0; outline:0; background:none; color:var(--txt,#e8f1f5); font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--mut,#7d949e); text-transform:uppercase; }

components.description: One of six chronological watches, on the cover rack or as an archive card with a sparkline.
components.html: 05Cold War1946–1974
components.css: .ds-era { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; padding:14px 16px 16px 0; border:0; border-right:1px solid rgba(232,241,245,.07); background:none; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; border-radius:0; } .ds-era:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-era-n { font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.24em; color:var(--mut,#7d949e); } .ds-era-name { font-family:var(--sans,'Archivo',sans-serif); font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.01em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--txt,#e8f1f5); transition:color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-era-years { font-family:var(--mono,monospace); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.14em; color:var(--mut,#7d949e); } .ds-era-bar { display:block; height:2px; margin-top:8px; background:rgba(232,241,245,.12); overflow:hidden; } .ds-era-bar i { display:block; height:100%; background:rgba(255,182,72,.45); transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-era:hover .ds-era-name { color:var(--amber,#ffb648); } .ds-era:hover .ds-era-bar i { background:var(--amber,#ffb648); } .ds-era:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--amber,#ffb648); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Contact Dot
components.description: A plotted submarine: 7px dot in its propulsion colour on a 30px hit area; red and pinged when locked.
components.css: .ds-contact { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; width:30px; height:30px; } .ds-contact i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c,#e8f1f5); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(232,241,245,.08), 0 0 12px var(--c,#e8f1f5); transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-contact:hover i { transform:scale(1.5); } .ds-contact.is-locked i { width:11px; height:11px; background:var(--alarm,#ff4d3d); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,77,61,.18), 0 0 22px rgba(255,77,61,.8); } .ds-contact.is-locked::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-12px; border:1px solid rgba(255,77,61,.5); border-radius:50%; }

narrative.overview: The archive behaves like the plot in a submarine's control room at night: a dark sea, a handful of cool instrument readouts, and amber reserved for whatever is live. Map tiles are literally the floor of the page — the sticky plot stays behind the cover, the operations console and the register while the archive scrolls over it. Nothing is decorated to look technical; the technical objects — coordinates, hull codes, years, counts — are the ornament. The voice is a working naval record, not a war game: heavy condensed uppercase headlines, mono labels at small size with wide tracking, and colour used only to encode data. Density is deliberate: panels sit on hairline rules, corners are square, and the only curves are contact dots, sonar rings and the sweep.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed Esri dark plot behind every surface, with contacts acquired on load.
One ink field, one text colour, one live accent (amber), one alarm (red).
Archivo condensed display plus Azeret Mono data labels; no third face.
Zero radius, one-pixel hairlines, tonal elevation instead of shadows.
Sequential entry: gate → boot telemetry → cover → console → watches → featured → briefing → origin.
Every count is generated from the JSON snapshot at runtime.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on ≤10% of any screen and always marks something alive or selected. If a surface needs emphasis and amber is already spent, use type weight or a hairline, not another colour.

rules.name: The Encoding Rule
rules.body: A colour that encodes data (propulsion, situation) never becomes a surface colour. It may appear as a dot, a badge, a border tint, a bar or text — never as a panel background.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Mono is for anything the instrument would measure or name: codes, years, counts, ranges, coordinates, labels, table cells. Running prose and headings are always Archivo.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface never gains a shadow to look important. If it must separate from the plot, it gains a hairline, a tonal step, or blur — never a cast shadow.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Halos exist only where something is transmitting: contacts, locks, the live indicator. A halo on a button or a card is a bug.

dos: Do keep the plot full-bleed and visible behind the cover, console and register.
Do reserve amber for live data and selection, and red for the single locked contact.
Do set every code, count, year and range in mono with 0.12em+ tracking.
Do use a hairline, a tonal step or blur to separate surfaces; keep corners at 0.
Do let the headline carry the section, with a mono note beside it for the count.
Do generate every number from the JSON snapshot at runtime.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion by removing the sweep, the reveals and the boot sequence.
donts: Don't add border-radius to surfaces or buttons; only data marks are round.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, panels or buttons.
Don't use amber or red as a surface fill beyond the primary button and the lock tint.
Don't place a kicker, eyebrow or numbered label above a heading.
Don't use mono for running prose, or Archivo for measurements.
Don't put a coloured left/right border thicker than 1px on cards or callouts.
Don't animate layout properties, or animate anything that is not a state change or the boot/plot sequence.
